import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
d = df[df['account_id']=='JUNpaMa'].copy()
anom = d[d['date']=='2025-10-16']
# previous Thursdays as same-weekday baseline
thurs = d[(d['date']<'2025-10-16') & (d['date'].dt.dayofweek==3) & (d['date']>='2025-09-01')]
print("total anom:", anom['unblended_cost'].sum(), "baseline Thurs avg:", thurs.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().mean())
base_vals = thurs.groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum()
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    a = anom.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()
    b = thurs.groupby('date').apply(lambda g: g.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()).mean()
    comp = pd.concat([a, b], axis=1, keys=['anom','base']).fillna(0)
    comp['diff'] = comp['anom']-comp['base']
    comp = comp[comp['diff'].abs()>0.5].sort_values('diff')
    print("\n=== ", col, " (n vals anom/base:", comp['anom'].ne(0).sum(), comp['base'].ne(0).sum(), ")")
    print(comp.to_string())
    print("sum diff:", comp['diff'].sum(), " residual vs total diff:", comp['diff'].sum() - (anom['unblended_cost'].sum()-base_vals.mean()))
